material_changes: Promote the academic noun 'abstract' (summary of a paper/article) to L1 alongside the abstract-versus-concrete adjective.
Separate the productive verb abstract A from B from the low-frequency summarize-as-a-verb use.
Make the academic noun and verb constructions learner-visible and note the noun/adjective versus verb stress shift.

core_clusters.label_en: existing as an idea rather than a concrete physical instance
a short summary of the main facts or ideas in a paper, article, or speech
extract or generalize something from a source; less commonly, summarize it

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 把具体细节拿开，只保留概念或关键信息；名词还表示论文/文章的摘要
core_concept.core_meaning_en: remove concrete detail to retain a concept or essential information; as a noun, a concise summary of a paper or article
core_concept.mental_model_cn: adj = 从具体实例抽离；noun = 把论文压成摘要；verb = 从材料中抽取/抽象出。
core_concept.mental_model_en: adjective: away from concrete instances; noun: compressed summary; verb: extract or generalize from a source

overrides.definition_cn: 抽象的；作为概念存在而非具体物体/实例的
overrides.definition_en: existing as an idea, quality, or general concept rather than a concrete physical instance
overrides.usage_note: As adjective/noun, stress is normally on the first syllable: AB-stract.

overrides.definition_cn: 摘要；尤指论文、文章或报告的简短概要
overrides.definition_en: a short summary giving the main facts or ideas of a paper, article, book, or speech
overrides.sense_label_en: summary of a paper or article
overrides.usage_note: High-value academic noun: read/write/submit an abstract.

overrides.definition_cn: 从具体材料中抽取、抽象出概念或特征
overrides.definition_en: to extract or generalize an idea, feature, or information from a more concrete source
overrides.sense_label_en: extract or generalize from a source
overrides.usage_note: As a verb, stress normally shifts to the second syllable: ab-STRACT.

overrides.definition_en: less commonly, to make a summary or abstract of something
overrides.usage_note: Lower-frequency verb use; do not confuse it with the much more common noun abstract.

constructions.meaning_cn: 从 B 中抽取/抽象出 A
